items.title: How were the 170 stale Amsterdam records handled?
assumptions: HTTP reachability, a redirect, or a restricted response does not confirm any catalogue fact.
A record remains unconfirmed until named fields are compared with an authoritative source.

source.label: YouNew governed catalog disposition

metricDefinitions.label: Confirmed current
metricDefinitions.definition: Confirmed current counts records whose named facts received field-level review against a recorded authoritative source.

metricDefinitions.label: Safely excluded
metricDefinitions.definition: Safely excluded counts stale effective-head records blocked from generated public pages and SEO output without deleting their governed source data.

caveats: The public package contains seven accepted governed records; the 170 exclusions remain editorial freshness debt.

evidenceFlow.title: Partition check
evidenceFlow.detail: The 177 governed source records reconcile to seven accepted public records plus 170 exact freshness exclusions.

evidenceFlow.title: Public package check
evidenceFlow.detail: The public-safe data-health gate found no excluded record in the generated public dataset.

preview.note: Complete aggregate of the Phase 4 Amsterdam disposition; row-level details remain in the governed JSON and CSV.

items.title: Did the migration chain and application round trip pass?

source.label: YouNew disposable Supabase evidence

metricDefinitions.label: Complete database tests
metricDefinitions.definition: Complete database tests are the pgTAP assertions executed after a clean disposable reset across all 15 SQL test files.

metricDefinitions.label: Successful Edge round trip
metricDefinitions.definition: A successful Edge round trip returned HTTP 201 and produced the expected application, consent and PII-minimised notification records in the isolated database.

caveats: A hosted staging project was not modified; the isolated staging target was the local disposable stack.

evidenceFlow.title: Source migration integrity
evidenceFlow.detail: Fifty-two historical source migrations and 18 pending migrations were checked byte-for-byte; generated compatibility normalisations stayed outside the source files.

evidenceFlow.title: Security tests
evidenceFlow.detail: The suite exercised RLS, relation privileges, function execution, rate limits, deduplication and notification privacy.

evidenceFlow.title: Round-trip persistence
evidenceFlow.detail: The two isolated HTTP submissions returned distinct confirmation IDs and exactly two expected application rows before fixture cleanup.

preview.note: Recorded validation outcomes; synthetic form values and credentials are excluded.

source.label: YouNew restore verification

links.label: Supabase restore to a new project

metricDefinitions.label: Restore pass
metricDefinitions.definition: Restore pass means the encrypted logical archive restored into a fresh isolated PostgreSQL target and the recorded schema and managed-boundary inventory matched.

caveats: The one-second RTO is a local synthetic measurement and is not a production recovery promise.
RPO requires the timestamp of the real production backup.
Database dumps contain Storage metadata, not Storage object payloads; Edge functions and project settings are checked separately.

evidenceFlow.title: Integrity check
evidenceFlow.detail: The restore used the manifest-bound archive and managed-boundary companion; digest mismatch is a hard failure.

evidenceFlow.title: Restored inventory
evidenceFlow.detail: The isolated target contained 43 public tables, 98 policies, 61 functions, three buckets and 52 migration records.

preview.note: Complete aggregate inventory from the isolated restore verifier.

items.title: How many companies are ready for lawful first contact?
assumptions: A company website, public general contact page or business-interest page is not by itself consent for digital direct marketing.
Ready for contact requires a recorded human decision that the exact channel and purpose are legally appropriate.

source.label: YouNew Phase 4 partner verification wave

metricDefinitions.label: Identity evidence
metricDefinitions.definition: Identity evidence counts supplied organisations whose name and identity were observed on their official public site.

metricDefinitions.label: Ready for lawful contact
metricDefinitions.definition: Ready for lawful contact counts organisations with both a suitable published channel and a documented channel-specific legal decision; no such decisions were completed.

caveats: Fourteen records can advance to manual legal and channel review but are not approved for sending.

evidenceFlow.title: Identity and route classification
evidenceFlow.detail: Identity evidence was observed for 27 organisations and public routes for 16; route purpose was classified separately.

evidenceFlow.title: No false contact status
evidenceFlow.detail: The tracker records zero ready, sent, replied, interested and registered organisations.

preview.note: Aggregate status only; direct contact identifiers are deliberately excluded.
